title: Claypot-Style Braised Tofu and Mushrooms with Rice

steps.text: Press the tofu dry, cube it and sear in the sesame oil until each face is gold and squeaky; lift out.
Brown the mushrooms hard in the same pot — no stirring at first — then add the garlic and ginger for thirty seconds.
Add the rinsed rice, gochujang, soy and stock, stir once, and bring to a boil.
Tuck the tofu back in, cover, and steam on the lowest heat until the rice drinks the liquid — no peeking for the first while.
Rest covered for five minutes off the heat, then fluff gently and finish with scallions.
